blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Miel Fajardo is finally getting his much-awaited world title shot. RCT Promotions, the Hong Kong–based outfit that co-promotes and manages Fajardo, announced that the 26-year-old Filipino will challenge International Boxing Federation (IBF) flyweight champion Masamichi Yabuki on November 26 at the Ebara Wave Arena in Tokyo, Japan.
